model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of several methods as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis represents "Co-occurrence Number" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to about 5,000, with tick marks at 10⁰·⁷ (~5), 10¹, 10², 10³, and beyond. The y-axis represents "ACC (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 37% to 65%, with tick marks at intervals of 5 percentage points. Six lines are shown, each corresponding to a different method. The black line with circle markers ("Base") starts at approximately 37% at the lowest co-occurrence number, rises slightly to about 43.5% around co-occurrence number 100, and then remains relatively flat at approximately 43.5% at the highest co-occurrence values. The light blue line with downward-triangle markers ("FT") begins near 40% and increases gradually to approximately 47.5% at the highest co-occurrence number. The red line with upward-triangle markers ("IKE") starts at roughly 43% and rises to about 49% at the rightmost point. The brown line with diamond markers ("MEND") begins at approximately 44.5% and increases steadily to around 56.5% at the highest co-occurrence number. The purple line with pentagon markers ("MEMIT") starts near 43.5%, rises to about 51% at co-occurrence number ~30, reaches approximately 53% around 300, and ends at roughly 55% at the highest value. The green line with square markers ("ROME") starts at approximately 51% at the lowest co-occurrence number, increases to about 57% around co-occurrence 30, continues rising to approximately 62% near 300, and reaches the highest value of approximately 65.5% at the largest co-occurrence number.
